posts.fullName: Karina | Stay at Home Mom + Digital Marketing
posts.caption:
Every Tuesday at lunch, I told my husband I was eating.

I wasn’t.  I was sitting in my car. Alone. Crying.

Doing the math in my head over and over. wondering how  we’d survive on one income . 

💸Co

I’m really trying to finish this challenge of posting for 30 days straight, it’s late, this is my post for the day 😂🧯🚒👩‍🚒
